Security defect, reproduced in Phase 1.5: the hold-cancel path has no owner check. HoldsApi.cancel receives member_id but HoldPolicy.check_cancel deletes any hold that exists, so one member can cancel another's hold. I have not filed this anywhere and its details should stay out of issues, PRs and commit messages: report it privately through the repository's security policy or a private vulnerability advisory.
